targets.query:
from(bucket: "moj_bucket")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "GYROSCOPE")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "acceleration")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "moj_bucket")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "GYROSCOPE")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "rotation")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "moj_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) // Koristi Grafana varijable
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ALARM")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "raw_data")

from(bucket: "moj_bucket")

  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

from(bucket: "moj_bucket")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "4SD")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "moj_bucket")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "DMS")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "attempt" or r._field == "value")
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "moj_bucket")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "LCD")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

from(bucket: "moj_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "DHT_3")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "humidity" or r._field == "temperature")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
